_about: What each player actually runs on the platform. deploy/paste-ready.md and the dashboard's Current Deployment card are generated from this. 'prompt': 'current' means prompts/<slot>/current.md; any other value is an explicit file (an override). Update this file whenever what's deployed differs from current.md, and remove an override when a release replaces it. DEF tried Nova Micro in match 022 (830 ms, no faster than Haiku) and is back on Claude Haiku from v13.
